//: Written by Tools/MapDataCompiler - it records which region layer provinces.png was cut from, so a mismatch can say so instead of looking like a corrupt map. The region hash here was restamped by hand once, when two whole provinces moved from Salyan to Nakhchivan: the region layer changed and the province cut did not have to, because the cells that moved are exactly those provinces. A recut would have been the same map with ninety-four fewer provinces and every id in the world shifted. What guarantees the two halves still fit is not this number but the load-time rule that no province may straddle a region border.
